context_requirements: Expression of LXRα (NR1H3) and/or LXRβ (NR1H2) and the obligate heterodimer partner RXR (RXRB)
Functional LXR response elements in target gene promoters
Cellular cholesterol homeostasis pathways that can be modulated by LXR activation
For anti-proliferative/apoptotic effects: dependence on NF-κB, Akt, or STAT5 survival signaling
falsifiers: No significant upregulation of canonical LXR target genes (e.g., ABCA1, ABCG1, APOE) at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
No change in cholesterol synthesis genes (e.g., HMGCR, HMGCS1, INSIG1) at 24 h
No anti-proliferative or apoptotic signature at 24 h in cell lines known to express LXR
Lack of dose-dependent transcriptional response across the nine cell lines

evidence.supports: LXR agonist T0901317 upregulates lipid metabolism/transport genes and downregulates immune/inflammatory and apoptosis genes in vivo
LXR agonist restores cholesterol efflux genes (ABCA1, ABCG1) and triggers apoptosis in BPDCN cells
LXR agonist ATI-829 increases ABCA1 expression in macrophages and is a poor inducer of SREBP1c in HepG2 cells
LXR agonist T0901317 inhibits proliferation, induces p21/p27, G1 arrest, and apoptosis in ovarian cancer cells

changes: Removed NR1H2 from proximal_up and late_up: LXR agonist does not transcriptionally upregulate its own receptor.
Removed NR1H2 from proximal_down and late_down: no evidence that LXR agonist downregulates NR1H2.
Removed PMID 17420776 from evidence: abstract concerns angiotensin II pressor responses and vascular ATR expression, not LXR target gene transcription.
